verdict.rationale: Ubuntu Desktop is a locally installed operating system. User data lives on the user's own hardware, so choosing a hosted storage region or residency is a category error for this product type. Nothing in the evidence shows Ubuntu Desktop offering any hosted data-storage service where a region could be chosen. Disk encryption (TPM) is a related local-security feature, not region or residency selection.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
